page.layout: One page of running text, with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head above the text at the top. Page number top right. Gathering signature bottom centre.

main_text.p: Eam primò simpliciter proponemus, dein-de ejusdem confirmationem adjiciemus, cer-tis theorematis comprehensam.

p.i: Sententia nostra de partitione philosophia talis est.

main_text.p: Ordo disciplinarum est vel dignitatis & Ordo disci-plinarum duplex. naturæ, vel doctrinæ.
Ordo dignitatis est, quo disciplinæ collocantur eâ serie, quam natura obtinent. Estq; talis.
Disciplina philosophica est vel theoretica, vel practica, vel poetica.

p.i: Theoretica est, quæ agit de rebus necessariis, adeoq; Disciplinæ theoreticæ numero 12[?]. tradit cognitionem veri.
Sapientia est Metaphysica, quæ considerat ens 1. Metaphy-sica. in quantum ens.
Scientia est vel pura, vel media.
Pura est vel Physica, vel Mathematica.
Physica est vel generalis, vel specialis.

main_text.p: Physiologia generalis est, quæ explicat proprie-tates rerum naturalium in genere. Fonseca 4.Me-taph.c.1. q.2.f.2. 2. Physica ge-neralis.
Specialis est vel Pneumatica, 3. Pneuma-tica. 4.de Angelis & a-nima:vel Somatologia, Somatolo-gia. de corporibus.

p.i: Mathematica est vel generalis, vel specialis.

main_text.p: Generalis est, quæ tractat principia & affectio- 5. Mathema-tica generalis. nes multitudini & magnitudini communes. Pererius l.1. c.17. p.57.
Scientia media est, quæ partim physica est, Ma-thematica partim. Fonseca 2.Metaph.c.3.q.2.f.5.

page.notes: Doubtful: "numero 12" in the note beside "Theoretica est" is printed small and the final digits are unclear. The "Estq" abbreviation may carry a stroke over the q that is hard to see. Several notes carry numbers printed above them (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7), which I kept with the notes they belong to. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout.
